title: 茶水间英文 - 10月24日 | Destiny's Child重聚、AI断网训练、高司令复出
description:
Destiny's Child surprised everyone by reuniting on stage at Jay-Z's 30th anniversary concert in Los Angeles, with Rihanna, John Legend, and more joining the party. Alex and Jordan also dig into OpenAI's decision to train its smartest models offline, plus Ryan Gosling's Halloween-perfect revival of his ghost band.

天后组合 Destiny's Child 惊喜现身 Jay-Z 洛杉矶 30 周年演唱会，Rihanna、John Legend 等一众巨星同台，堪称年度重聚。两人还聊了 OpenAI 给最先进模型断网训练的决定，以及高司令赶在万圣节前复活幽灵乐队的有趣操作。

Words to steal 生词本：
- reunion — 重聚；重逢
- take the stage — 登台；登场
- guest list — 嘉宾名单
- frontier models — 最前沿模型
- guardrails — 安全护栏；防护措施
- digital detox — 数字戒断；远离电子设备
- comeback — 复出；回归
- on brand — 很符合人设；一贯风格
